rules.rule: a value of 64 hexadecimal digits that its name says is a private key
12 or more words of the BIP-39 English list in a row
an RPC address with what looks like an API key in its path, query or user part
an approval or a permit whose amount is the largest uint256
a request of eth_sign, or a call of x.eth.sign
personal_sign or signMessage of a message built from fields
a typed data domain literal with no chainId or no verifyingContract
a file that connects a wallet or sends a transaction with no chain id, chainChanged or network switch in it
a mixed-case address whose case does not match EIP-55
an address in several files of code, or in the code and a configuration map
a contract name with two addresses for one chain id in two JSON files
window.web3, ethereum.enable(), or eth_accounts with no request for accounts in the project
an HTML sink fed from a name of token metadata or of the chain, with no sanitizer
a wait for 0 or 1 confirmation in a file that moves value, against a setting of 2 or more
a file that the tool could not read
a folder or a file past a limit of the run

findings.found: DEPLOYER_MNEMONIC holds 12 words of the BIP-39 English list in a row in an env file of the repository, though they do not pass the BIP-39 checksum; the words are not shown
findings.fix: take the phrase out of the repository and out of its history, treat every account of it as known to everyone and move what they hold; a test that needs a phrase builds it at run time

basis.text: a mnemonic has 12, 15, 18, 21 or 24 words of a list of 2,048, each standing for 11 bits, and its last bits are a checksum taken from the SHA-256 hash of the entropy
basis.source: BIP-39: Mnemonic code for generating deterministic keys (Bitcoin Improvement Proposals)

basis.text: the English word list holds 2,048 words in a fixed order, one per line, and the index of a word is its place in the list
basis.source: The BIP-39 English word list, english.txt (Bitcoin Improvement Proposals)

basis.text: a recovery phrase or a private key is never to be shared for any reason, and never kept in digital form such as a screenshot
the seed phrase of a wallet is written down and kept offline, never on a computer, because whoever holds it holds the account
secrets hard coded in source and configuration files are a common leak; .env files are not to be committed, and client-side code is not to hold secrets at all

findings.own: 12 or more words in a row, all of the BIP-39 English list, in a string, a fixed part of a template, a JSON string or an env value; the report says whether the BIP-39 checksum of the phrase holds, and a run whose checksum fails is still reported, because it may be a real phrase with one word changed; the words are never shown

findings.found: the code asks the wallet for eth_sign, which in MetaMask signed any hash with no prefix, a transaction included, so a user could not see what was signed; MetaMask has removed the method
findings.fix: sign typed data with eth_signTypedData_v4 (EIP-712), or text the user can read with personal_sign

basis.text: eth_sign lets a site have a user blindly sign any hash, a transaction included, so MetaMask removes the method and answers it with an error
eth_signTypedData_v4 gives the most readable signatures that are efficient to check on chain, personal_sign suits text such as Sign-In with Ethereum, and eth_sign is deprecated

basis.text: innerHTML, outerHTML and document.write treat their value as HTML, so a variable is not to be put there, and HTML that must be shown is cleaned first, such as with DOMPurify

findings.found: the address 0xa30A33DbBa2306021D3143805837911EE55e092C mixes upper and lower case but does not match the EIP-55 checksum, which is 0xa30A33dbBa2306021D3143805837911EE55e092C; a typo in one digit would read the same

basis.text: an address is checksummed by hashing its 40 lowercase digits with Keccak-256 and writing each letter in upper case where the digit of the hash at its place is 8 or more; all lower and all upper case stay valid with no checksum
basis.source: ERC-55: Mixed-case checksum address encoding (Ethereum Improvement Proposals)

findings.own: an address of 40 hexadecimal digits after 0x, in a string, a JSON file or an env file, with upper and lower case letters that do not match the checksum of EIP-55, worked out with the Keccak-256 of the tool itself; an address all in lower or all in upper case has no checksum and is not reported; the report names the address with its right checksum

findings.fix: read the address from the environment at build time and keep the key out of the repository; for a front end, use a key restricted to your domains and methods, or send the calls through a server of your own, and rotate the key that was committed

basis.text: MaxUint256 is the constant for the largest value of a uint256

notice: This check reads the source, JSON and env files on disk as text and runs nothing, calls no node and fetches nothing; the checks are a heuristic, and no secret value is shown. A finding is a lead with a file and a line for a review of how the app talks to wallets and chains, and a clean result is not a security audit and not a guarantee that the app is safe (docs/limits.md).
